title.de: rose bowl flea market in pasadena.

line.en: the monthly market on the rose bowl stadium lot: over 2,500 vendors, vintage, antiques and art.
line.de: der monatliche markt auf dem parkplatz des rose bowl stadions: über 2.500 händler, vintage, antiquitäten und kunst.
line.tr: rose bowl stadyumu otoparkında aylık pazar: 2.500'den fazla satıcı, vintage, antika ve sanat.

sparks.why: Second Sunday of the month, 8 November 2026, per coloradoboulevard.net and Pasadena Now; hours vary between sources (9am start in most), so check the Eventbrite listing.

title.en: vocal jazz jam at the world stage.
title.tr: the world stage'de vokal caz jam'i.

line.en: open vocal jazz jam at the world stage in crenshaw on sunday evening. come to listen or sing; check the listing for the current start time.
line.de: offene vokal-jazz-jam im the world stage in crenshaw am sonntagabend. zum zuhören oder singen; die aktuelle startzeit steht auf der seite.
line.tr: crenshaw'daki the world stage'de pazar akşamı açık vokal caz jam'i. dinlemeye ya da şarkı söylemeye gel; güncel saat ilanda.

sparks.why: Recent Eventbrite listing for a Sunday vocal jazz jam at The World Stage Performance Gallery, 4321 Degnan Blvd; the 8 pm start comes from a venue directory and is not confirmed on the listing.
